title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E05 — Uncovering Houston BBQ's Asian Influences
Pat meets the trio behind Blood Bros BBQ to discover how three childhood friends seamlessly blended their Asian-American culture with the Texas barbecue traditions they grew up with.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E03 — Barbecued Pork Steak
Pat Martin travels to Gainesboro, Tennessee to visit a free-range hog farm, learn about their operations, and grill up a less desired, but no less delicious, cut of hog - pork steaks.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S11 E06 — Pioneering From Farm to Table
Gaby Molinar owns Huerto Urbano, an urban farm dedicated to providing Monterrey with nutritious, diverse local ingredients. And her husband is one of the region's greatest culinary pioneers.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S09 E08 — Super Sonoran
Pati makes three classic Sonoran recipes: a fish special called pescado zarandeado, a rich stew called gallina pinta and a tasty dirty rice with clams. In Sonora, she visits vacation destination Puerto Peñasco.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S11 E03 — The World Cup of Tacos
Nuevo León is divided between two pro soccer teams: Los Tigres and Los Rayados. Pati tries the food at each stadium with the teams' stars to determine who wins in the battle of tortas vs tacos.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S09 E07 — Legends of the Sonoran Sea
Pati travels to Sonora's coast on the Sea of Cortez, where local legend Toño Contreras gives her a tour including shellfish on the beach, his restaurant Mariscos El Rey, and his home kitchen for some crave-worthy recipes.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S09 E06 — Sonoran Family Favorites
Pati spends a day in the kitchen with her middle son, Sami, cooking recipes inspired by her travels in Sonora that she knows he'll love - beef and potato chimichangas, rice with lentils and caramelized onions, and an avocado and radish salad.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S11 E02 — Sisters, Stew, and Sass
Two sisters made a little shack on the Rio Ramos into a must-visit restaurant known for one dish: cortadillo stew. Down the road, another restaurant uses traditional stews in their famous empalmes.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E10 — The Ultimate Elk Tailgate
It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E09 — Southern Shrimp Skewers and Asian Crispy Rice
Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E07 — The Wild Boar Playbook
Andrew turns wild boar into the ultimate game-day spread with boar and black bean chili topped with crisp cornbread waffles, and pulled boar sliders braised low and slow in Carolina Gold mustard sauce.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E02 — Back to Our Caveman Roots
Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E03 — The Most Underrated Game Bird
Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E01 — Grilled Squid Salad and Crispy Squid on the Plancha
Andrew Zimmern creates a vibrant salad where grilled squid is served with shaved fennel, cherry tomatoes, endive, and a lemon dressing. Then, Andrew shares his country-style squid on the plancha with fresh breadcrumbs, chilies, and a homemade aioli.

title: Jamie Oliver's Ultimate BBQ
description:
S01 E01 — Grilled Steak Salad and Italian-style Lamb Chops
Jamie shares his perfect Steak & Chargrilled Salad, a Chicken Caesar Salad with an upgrade on the bars, Italia-inspired Sizzling Lamb Lollipops and his delicious Whole Barbecue Fish & Ratatouille to upgrade your grill skills!

title: Jamie Oliver's Ultimate BBQ
description:
S01 E02 — Grilled Fish Tacos and a Veggie Pancake
For the ultimate BBQ experience, Jamie cooks a Butterflied Leg of Lamb, his Spiced Chicken Kebabs and creamy butter sauce perfect for a party, followed by Grilled Fish Tacos and Jamie's Tear 'n' Share Veggie Pancake ready to feed a crowd.

title: Jamie Oliver's Ultimate BBQ
description:
S01 E03 — Sesame Chicken Burger and Surf & Turf Mixed Grill
Jamie takes outdoor cooking to new heights with his Ultimate Barbecue Breakfast, a smoke-kissed Sesame Chicken Burger, his Veggie Barbecue Mezze offering an epic spread; and his Surf & Turf Mixed Grill is a perfect party crowd-pleaser!

title: Backyard BBQ Hero
description:
S01 E02 — Steakhouse Hero
Susie's bringing in a special guest so you can bring the steakhouse to your backyard! Christie Vanover of Girls Can Grill joins the fun and brings some fingerling potatoes to round out the ribeyes, asparagus, and a one-of-a-kind compound butter!

title: Backyard BBQ Hero
description:
S01 E03 — Pulled Pork Party Hero
It's always kind of a party in the backyard, but it's really a party when Susie breaks out the smoker for some legendary pulled pork sliders, a homemade coleslaw, and a mac and cheese so creamy even the grownups will rave about it.

title: Backyard BBQ Hero
description:
S01 E06 — Smoked Brisket Hero
Pitmaster Jason Neeley (Pica Rica BBQ) drops by the backyard to share some insider tips for nailing the perfect brisket and helps Susie make pickled vegetables to go alongside her dad's hot potato salad! This is a must-watch for serious Pitmasters.

title: Backyard BBQ Hero
description:
S01 E04 — Mexican Carne Asada Hero
Grill fatigue is a very real problem, but the globally-inspired menu of carne asada, tomatillo salsa, Mexican street corn, and Tex-Mex beans in this episode of Backyard BBQ Hero is sure to reignite the fire inside and get you outside cooking!

title: Backyard BBQ Hero
description:
S01 E05 — Santa Maria Tri-tip Hero
If you love outdoor grilling AND flexing your skills by entertaining guests, the next Backyard BBQ Hero is required viewing. Fire up the grill for a show-stopping Santa Maria-style tri tip, a zesty salad, and an unbelievable dinner bread!

title: Backyard BBQ Hero
description:
S01 E01 — Weeknight Family Dinner Hero
Susie from Hey Grill Hey teaches you how to make a full family dinner right in your own backyard in under 30 minutes! When you serve this grilled honey mustard chicken, creamed corn, and mixed veggies, you'll feel like a Weeknight BBQ Hero!

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E05 — Pit-Cooked Chicken with Alabama White Sauce
Pat Martin travels to Decatur, Alabama to visit a storied institution of barbecue - Big Bob Gibson's. There, he learns the ins, the outs, and the history of a regional delicacy: pit-cooked chicken with Alabama white sauce.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E01 — Discovering Indian Lamb Kebabs in Nashville
Pat grills riverside with renowned chef Vivek Surti, crafting lamb kofta and chicken kebabs inspired by his Indian heritage.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E02 — Searching for Oaxaca in Tennessee
Pat visits Edgar Victoria, known for bringing the street foods of Mexico City to Nashville, to do some live fire cooking out in nature as they prepare one of his favorite dishes - skirt steak tlayuda.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E06 — Greek Spit Roast Lamb
Pat Martin links up with his pal, Bill Darsinos, to enjoy a tradition from the heart of Bill's Greek culture when they cook a whole lamb on a spit roast.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E09 — Bluefin Tuna Collars with Chili Pickle Relish
Pat Martin visits chef Adam Perry Lang in Los Angeles, where the pair cooks a prized catch castoff cut - Bluefin Tuna collars.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E03 — The Legend of Louis Mueller's Dino Beef Ribs
Pat visits his close friend Wayne Mueller, third-generation pitmaster of Louis Mueller's BBQ, to learn the ins and outs of his famous dino beef ribs.

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E05 — Peperonata Eggs on Toast and Baked Cinnamon Apples
Jamie makes a no-cook store-cupboard olive pasta sauce, a cheap frozen-pepper peperonata stew with coddled eggs, a wallet-friendly chicken thigh and bean roast dinner, and budget-clever homemade takeaway kebabs with flatbreads!

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E06 — Easy Chicken Curry and Feta Tomato Pasta
Jamie makes an air-fryer tomato and roast feta pasta using leftover noodles, a budget rolled carrot cake, and a cheap family chicken curry. Plus, an epic cheese-on-toast Welsh rarebit upgrade and frozen fish Chinese-inspired dough parcels!

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E02 — Better Than Takeout: Indian-Spiced Lentils
Jamie makes frugal leftovers fun with spaghetti frittata, bakes air-fryer pork pies using affordable mince, and preps a batch of butternut squash dal. Plus, budget-friendly chicken shish kebabs and thrifty mint choc chip whoopie pies!

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E01 — The Best Fish You're Not Eating
Andrew takes on "little fish, big fish," cooking grilled whole small fish over Japanese charcoal with sesame spinach, and a larger fish in a bold puttanesca-style dish. Simple techniques, big flavor, and a case for eating lower on the food chain.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E04 — Mediterranean Grilled Filets and Salt Crusted Halibut
Andrew Zimmern elevates California halibut, first with grilled fillets on saffron labneh with romesco and roasted cabbage. Then, he demonstrates a classic salt-crusted whole halibut, served with whole roasted cauliflower and a rich cream sauce.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E06 — Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast
Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E04 — Grilled Rabbit with Panzanella Salad
Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E01 — The Essence of Grill Culture
Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E05 — Bison Brats & Grilled Kebabs on Flatbread
Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.

title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean
description:
S01 E02 — Making Couscous in Tunisia
Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew.

title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean
description:
S01 E01 — Traditional Greek Cuisine
Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice.

title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean
description:
S01 E04 — Stunning Seafood of Marseille
Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart.

title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean
description:
S01 E03 — Inspirational Spanish Tapas
Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S01 E06 — Cauliflower Star Power
Cauliflower can be transformed into unexpected, delicious and nutritious dishes; Frankie discusses why to buy dried-goods in bulk and makes a big chuck roast that stretches over three dishes.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S08 E10 — Too Hot To Cook
When the temps are soaring and turning on your stove or oven is not even an option, Frankie's no cook meals will blow you away. Enjoy refreshing, nourishing dishes that will help keep you cool all summer long.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S02 E03 — Plant-Based Budget Meals
Frankie busts the myth that eating plant-based is expensive. Preparing these good-for-you meals is all about eating seasonally to save money on produce, and shopping the bulk aisle for even more savings on plant-based pantry items.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S08 E09 — Picnic Lunches
It's field trip day, and Frankie shows off his best handheld lunches perfect for leisurely days at the park, the beach or the pool. These sturdy meals are made to travel and only get better with time.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S03 E02 — Winter Is Here
The struggle is real, but it doesn't mean your food has to suffer. Chef Frankie Celenza shows you how to make delicious meals that won't break the bank.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S04 E08 — Crunchy
Reaching textural nirvana is never easy, but Frankie explores several ways to achieve the perfect crunch in his dishes, both savory and sweet. Add this elusive element to your recipes without adding cost to your budget.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S04 E01 — Warm + Cozy Winter
Frankie gets cozy in the kitchen with recipes that bring all the warmth, flavor and joy during the coldest days of winter; from a casual weekday dinner to a special weekend meal.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S06 E09 — Bananas For Bananas
As one of the cheapest members of the produce aisle, bananas will save you bunches of money when you whip up these delightfully appealing recipes that go above and beyond basic bread.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S03 E01 — Game Day
Frankie throws a game day party for under $25. Game days aren't for dinner parties, but they are a day for some fan-favorite finger foods, especially those you can make in advance. Frankie makes three no-fuss appetizers.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S09 E06 — Whole Chicken 101
Join Frankie to learn the ins and outs of using every part of a chicken, as he demonstrates how to maximize the value and minimize waste. By cooking smarter, you'll have three delectable recipes to last you the whole week.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S07 E02 — French Bistro
Bonsoir, indeed! Join Frankie as he cooks up elegant but achievable French classics that will transport you to an evening on the Seine, complete with some savvy wine tips without the hefty cost of a plane ticket.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S05 E06 — Spooktacular Tricks and Treats
Frankie's got tricks and treats up his sleeve this Halloween with simple, wicked good dishes for all to enjoy.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E01 — Weeknight Roast Lamb and Eggplant
Jamie kicks off his new one-pan series with a simplified and delicious frying-pan pasta, a clever twist on a fish pie that's full of flavour with none of the fuss, and a sublime roast lamb feast with a fantastic hack to speed up cooking.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E02 — Speedy Chicken and Mushroom Puff Pastry Pie
Jamie cooks three one-pan recipes that provide a perfect solution for busy life: a superfast, flavour-packed smoky noodle soup; the cleverest homemade bread in a pan; and a chicken & mushroom pie with a time-saving tip for perfect pastry.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E07 — Salmon Pasta, a Loaded Burger, and Sticky Toffee Apple Buns!
Jamie cooks three one-pan recipes: smoked salmon pasta, a loaded beef burger, and sticky toffee apple buns.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E08 — An Eggplant Burger, Seared Salmon, & Squash Casserole!
Jamie shares three easy one-pan wonders: an aubergine burger, sesame salmon, and chickpea & squash casserole!

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E06 — Jamie's Outrageously Good Pulled Pork
Jamie cooks two one-pan recipes that are ideal for busy lives: his take on shakshuka with asparagus, broccoli & harissa; and an outrageously good pulled pork that can be batched up, frozen and used in loads of meals whenever you're ready.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E05 — Sweet Potato Chilli and Homemade Nachos
Jamie shows us a delicious range of one-pan dishes: a super-speedy smashed lemongrass chicken; flavour-packed sweet potato chilli with homemade nachos; and a chocolate party tray cake with retro tinned-mandarin and buttercream filling.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S06 E05 — Fancy Pants Pasta
Treat yourself to a five-star pasta dinner, as Frankie cooks his signature dishes with showstopping sauces.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S04 E04 — Struggle Soup
Warm and hearty bowls of veggies, beans, pasta, and more, these soups will have you returning for seconds all year round. Frankie's soup blueprints can turn everyday ingredients into extraordinary soups, with endless flavor opportunity.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S08 E06 — But First, Brunch
Bring your loved ones together over a delicious brunch spread made with love. Whether you're celebrating a major milestone or simply toasting to the weekend, Frankie's money-saving menu will have guests buzzing for more.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S06 E03 — A Leftover Glowup
Put leftovers to good use with tasty, waste-reducing recipes that turn excess food into exciting new dishes.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S06 E04 — Romantic Steakhouse Dinner
Give your wallet a break by taking the fine-dining experience straight to the comfort of your home. From tender, juicy steak paired with classic sides, to decadent desserts, Frankie's got your date night meal covered.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S09 E12 — 100th Episode
Frankie celebrates the 100th episode of Struggle Meals with a look back on memorable moments, favorite recipes, bloopers and cooking mishaps. Take a peek behind the scenes, hear from the audience, and celebrate with a special surprise guest.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E01 — Weeknight Roast Lamb and Eggplant
Jamie kicks off his new one-pan series with a simplified and delicious frying-pan pasta, a clever twist on a fish pie that's full of flavour with none of the fuss, and a sublime roast lamb feast with a fantastic hack to speed up cooking.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E02 — Speedy Chicken and Mushroom Puff Pastry Pie
Jamie cooks three one-pan recipes that provide a perfect solution for busy life: a superfast, flavour-packed smoky noodle soup; the cleverest homemade bread in a pan; and a chicken & mushroom pie with a time-saving tip for perfect pastry.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E07 — Salmon Pasta, a Loaded Burger, and Sticky Toffee Apple Buns!
Jamie cooks three one-pan recipes: smoked salmon pasta, a loaded beef burger, and sticky toffee apple buns.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E08 — An Eggplant Burger, Seared Salmon, & Squash Casserole!
Jamie shares three easy one-pan wonders: an aubergine burger, sesame salmon, and chickpea & squash casserole!

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E06 — Jamie's Outrageously Good Pulled Pork
Jamie cooks two one-pan recipes that are ideal for busy lives: his take on shakshuka with asparagus, broccoli & harissa; and an outrageously good pulled pork that can be batched up, frozen and used in loads of meals whenever you're ready.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E05 — Sweet Potato Chilli and Homemade Nachos
Jamie shows us a delicious range of one-pan dishes: a super-speedy smashed lemongrass chicken; flavour-packed sweet potato chilli with homemade nachos; and a chocolate party tray cake with retro tinned-mandarin and buttercream filling.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S06 E05 — Fancy Pants Pasta
Treat yourself to a five-star pasta dinner, as Frankie cooks his signature dishes with showstopping sauces.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S04 E04 — Struggle Soup
Warm and hearty bowls of veggies, beans, pasta, and more, these soups will have you returning for seconds all year round. Frankie's soup blueprints can turn everyday ingredients into extraordinary soups, with endless flavor opportunity.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S08 E06 — But First, Brunch
Bring your loved ones together over a delicious brunch spread made with love. Whether you're celebrating a major milestone or simply toasting to the weekend, Frankie's money-saving menu will have guests buzzing for more.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S06 E03 — A Leftover Glowup
Put leftovers to good use with tasty, waste-reducing recipes that turn excess food into exciting new dishes.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S06 E04 — Romantic Steakhouse Dinner
Give your wallet a break by taking the fine-dining experience straight to the comfort of your home. From tender, juicy steak paired with classic sides, to decadent desserts, Frankie's got your date night meal covered.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S10 E06 — Tradition and Innovation
Pati meets chef and historian Maru Toledo who is working to preserve and pass on some of Jalisco's most important regional recipes. Pati makes Jalisco-style chicken tamales and chile relleno rice dressed with salsa roja.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S11 E01 — The Fire Kings
Gualberto "Weber" Elizondo surprised his family when his grilling hobby turned him into a local celebrity and internet sensation. Meanwhile, chef Chuy Villareal of Cara De Vaca wants the world to know that the north of Mexico isn't just carne asada.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S12 E08 — Mayan Gateway To The Underworld
No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S10 E09 — Double Vallarta
Pati is in one of Mexico's most popular beach destinations - Puerto Vallarta. She gets an insider's tour of the best street food from one of the town's most acclaimed chefs, Thierry Boulet.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S10 E08 — The Heart of Tequila
Pati visits the birthplace of Mexico's most famous spirit, the town of Tequila. Back home Pati makes a brunch of corn tortilla egg nests with salsa verde con chile de árbol and traditional arroz rojo.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S12 E02 — Guayabera World
In Tekit, the capital of the Guayabera, Pati encounters a tale of sons going against their father's wishes to follow their own path. Pati meets a farmer's son who went against his father to build a family business making the iconic Guayabera shirts.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S10 E05 — Jalisco Style Birria
Pati experiences the Escaramuza — An all-female horse riding and skills competition. In the kitchen, Pati makes Jalisco-style birria and her friend, pastry chef and cookbook author Fany Gerson, joins her to make gelatinas for dessert.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S12 E09 — Yucatán's Most Unique Salts
An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S12 E05 — The Art of the Egg
Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S12 E04 — An Underground Pit of Cochinita Pibil
Pati visits Chef Wilson Alonzo in his hometown of Halachó to prepare a traditional Cochinita Pibil in an underground pit. Pati helps Wilson prepare the achiote marinade, along with his grandmother who taught him traditional cooking.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S10 E07 — Getting to the Roots
Pati meets the young chefs behind one of Guadalajara's most exciting restaurants, Xokol. Back home, Pati invites her friend Francisco Migoya over to make conchas to go with pellizcadas with chicharrón in salsa verde.
